name: popsicle
headline: Sociobot: Social Media Automation Platform
short_description: Sociobot is a PHP-based social media management and automation platform. It is built for teams or developers who need a self-hosted tool to manage social media workflows.
author: swagat-dash

sections.overview:
Sociobot is an open-source social media management and automation platform built primarily with PHP, JavaScript, and CSS. The project is structured with application logic, assets, and installation components, and supports deployment on platforms such as Heroku. It is designed for developers or marketers who want a self-hosted solution for managing social media activity. The codebase uses Composer for PHP dependency management, indicating a modular and extensible architecture. Sociobot is suited for those who prefer to own and operate their own social media automation infrastructure rather than relying on third-party SaaS tools.
Self-hosting a social media automation platform on a private server or Heroku
Managing social media workflows through a custom PHP-based application
Building and extending a social media management tool using open-source code
Automating social media tasks for marketing teams without third-party SaaS dependencies
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/swagat-dash/sociobot`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a sociobot for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Create a 3-day social media content calendar with engaging posts for [PLATFORM] (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram). Include hashtags and optimal posting times. Focus on [TOPIC] to boost engagement.
```
